## Investigation Report

### Verdict/Confidence/Severity/Task Type

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Verdict | Confirmed, bounded correctness defect |
| Confidence | High |
| Severity | Medium |
| Task Type | Targeted verification-preflight fix with regression coverage |

### What Was Claimed

Review finding `INIT-MONO-001` claims that malformed root `package.json` test metadata can cause verification to select a valid nested package instead of failing closed.

### What We Found

`preflightRequiredVerificationCommands` resolves and validates the configured `cwd`, then validates the package script at that exact directory. Missing, non-object, non-string, and blank script values are rejected by `assertPackageScript`. Existing coverage proves that a root command does not silently use a nested package when the root has no `test` script.

However, `packageScriptName` only inspects `argv[1]`. Package-manager selectors placed before the subcommand (for example `npm --prefix web test` or `npm --workspace web test`) return no script name, so preflight skips package metadata validation even though the package manager can execute `test` from the nested package while the process cwd remains the repository root. This is the remaining bypass for malformed root metadata.

### Root Cause

The package-manager argument parser assumes the script subcommand is always the second argv element. It does not recognize a script subcommand after supported selector/options, so the static package-script assertion can be bypassed.

### Affected Files

| Path | Change Needed |
|---|---|
| `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` | Parse script subcommands after package-manager options so nested selectors cannot bypass root metadata validation. |
| `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` | Add malformed-root and selector regression cases. |

### Evidence

- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts:57-59` validates a package only when `packageScriptName` returns a script.
- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts:119-129` reads only `argv[1]`, allowing selector-before-command forms to return `undefined`.
- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts:161-173` correctly treats non-object script maps and non-string/blank values as invalid once validation is reached.
- `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts:63-83` covers a missing root script with a valid nested package, but not malformed metadata or selector-before-command forms.
- `README.md` requires monorepo checks to bind `cwd` to the owning package and says invalid package scripts fail closed; CI-only verification is represented by an empty command map.

### History Findings

The supplied issue identifies source PR #110 and finding `INIT-MONO-001`; its evidence says a prior remediation treated malformed `scripts.test` values as invalid and added regression coverage. The current branch contains the direct-cwd validation portion, but the command parser still leaves an option-before-subcommand bypass. No unrelated history or scope is required.

### Recommendation

Keep the exact-cwd contract and fail-closed behavior. Extend the small package-manager parser to locate direct `test`/`run`/`run-script` subcommands after recognized selector/options, then assert the script in the configured cwd. Add focused tests proving malformed root metadata is rejected even when a nested package has a valid script, while an explicitly configured nested cwd remains valid. Users needing CI-only verification should remove local commands rather than rely on malformed package metadata.

### Related Issues

- Source review finding: `INIT-MONO-001` from PR #110.
- Source issue: #94.
- Current remediation issue: #114.

### Decomposition Assessment

This is a single cohesive change across one adapter and its focused test. No decomposition is warranted.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] Recognize package-manager script commands after supported selector/options without selecting a different cwd implicitly.
- [ ] Reject malformed root `scripts.test` values even when a nested package has a valid test script.
- [ ] Preserve valid explicitly configured nested-package verification.
- [ ] Add focused regression coverage and pass the required `check` verification.
- [ ] Re-review the exact remediation head.
